name: Structural steel — fabricated beams, columns, bracing
description: Primary gravity and lateral load-resisting frame for process structures, pipe racks, equipment supports and buildings; fabricated from rolled or welded sections in carbon, HSLA or high-strength grades. Primary source: https://americansteelandaluminum.com/resources/materials/a992-steel

specifications.basis: ASTM A992 preferred grade for W-shapes: 50 ksi min / 65 ksi max yield, 65 ksi min tensile, Fy/Fu <=0.85, CE <=0.45 (0.47 for flanges >2 in); AISC 341 expected yield = 1.1 x specified min
